purpose: Shared component pins and truthful readiness status for Founder-OS, CORE, PUBLIC, and PusingCuk.

authority_model.Founder-OS: Durable decisions, constraints, recovery context, curated knowledge index.
authority_model.kawasan-masjid-core: Runtime truth, authorization, operational data, AI orchestration, and evidence.
authority_model.kawasan-masjid-public: Public-safe web experience; never a second backend or private knowledge store.
authority_model.pusingcuk: Canonical language, specification, interpreter/native runtime, registered .cuk rules, and conformance.

capabilities.native_rule: One deterministic registered .cuk rule; exact source commit and source hash are pinned.
capabilities.founder_knowledge: Bounded lexical ranking over a curated 20-document public-safe multi-repository index; validates immutable source URLs against repository, path and source commit; returns source authority/evidence/claim status and uses deterministic validated citation footers. This remains lexical retrieval, not vector search.
capabilities.local_llm: Ollama provider adapter source; default model qwen3:4b; no hosted LLM API key required for local inference.
capabilities.runner_boundary: Authenticated local prototype; fixed execution endpoint, allowlist, strict input schema, timeout, output bound, minimum token length and capability denial.
capabilities.model_training: Not implemented; PusingCuk is a language/runtime, not a trained LLM.
capabilities.production_runner: Not deployed; local runner is not an OS sandbox and must not be internet-exposed.
capabilities.repository_freeze: Not approved until migration parity, auth/data/audit preservation, backups, restore and rollback are verified.
capabilities.additional_pusingcuk_rule: budget.sufficiency.v1 source and fixture are pinned and tested by PusingCuk reference tests plus CORE native CI; not yet exposed through the local HTTP rule runner.

verification_status.last_known_green_core_run_scope: Core Quality Gate passed on synchronized main commit 575c6c040fd7b2af8f8ab2d8dca19d2a0c180e87. It runs the automated 20-source immutable commit/path checks, seven Indonesian retrieval relevance queries, deterministic citation validation, lint/E2E/build, and native CI behavior for the existing threshold rule and added sufficiency rule. This is code/CI evidence, not live local Ollama inference or production deployment.
